text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
“—I'm okay.
I'm not completely exhausted today...!
I'm standing proud and tall...!”

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Following right up after the Champions Cup,
with results like this...!!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Everyooone!!
Thanks for all your suuupport!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna keep givin' it my all--!! Please keep cheerin' for me and Tomakomai--!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'd be mighty glad if y'all followed me
on Umatter and UmaTube, too!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: That's all from the migratory bird with paper wings, flying all the way from Tomakomai Port! Tomakomai's local idol, Hokko Tarumae!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
“—Trainer!
Let's decide on our next target race right now!”

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"After today, I've gained confidence...!
Confidence that I can stand tall
and compete on the front lines of dirt racing!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
So I want to build on this momentum
and deliver even better results...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Were my pre-race worries completely unfounded?
Hokko Tarumae looks in peak condition,
both mentally and physically."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If we're setting a target,
a race a bit further out from the Kawasaki Kinen
would make scheduling in between easier.
choice_data_list: Let's aim for the Kashiwa Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Judging from Hokko Tarumae's run today,
the Kashiwa Kinen should definitely be a race we can aim to win...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Understood!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Um, can I post on social media about aiming for the Kashiwa Kinen?
I'd like to get people interested as early as possible.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Well then, right away—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Huh—
N-No way! My name is trending on Umatter!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes! But I wonder why?
Could it be that the post-race promo went viral—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...What is... this...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that something was clearly wrong with Hokko Tarumae,
I hurriedly opened Umatter on my phone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then, I found the post
that caused her name to trend—

text_block_list.name: Controversial Post
text_block_list.text: "Hokko Tarumae is an incredible Umamusume. Today's race convinced me she'll undoubtedly lead the future of dirt racing, and I've become a fan."

text_block_list.name: Controversial Post
text_block_list.text: "Which is precisely why I think it's such a waste."

text_block_list.name: Controversial Post
text_block_list.text:
"‘To be honest, I wish Tarumae would focus on racing
instead of being a local idol. So that she can keep
shining on the front lines of dirt racing.’"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The post spread in the blink of an eye,
eventually sparking a heated debate—

text_block_list.name: Social Media Post A
text_block_list.text: "This Umatter OP doesn't get it at all! Tarumae's main thing is being a local idol! People like this need to stop pretending to be fans!"

text_block_list.name: Social Media Post B
text_block_list.text: "There are cases like Falco who pull off doing both, after all. It's just a shame she isn't quite the orthodox, classic idol type like Falco is."

text_block_list.name: Social Media Post C
text_block_list.text: "I only learned about Tarumae from racing too~. If she wants to make it big as an idol, I feel like holding onto that Tomakomai stuff is holding her back. Such a waste."

text_block_list.name: Social Media Post D
text_block_list.text: "Truth be told, I just like Hokko Tarumae's running; I don't really care about the local idol stuff. Pretty much agree with the Umart OP."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Taking that post as a trigger, all sorts of thoughts and opinions began swirling around completely outside of Hokko Tarumae's knowledge...
choice_data_list: Tarumae, let's head back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Taking her trembling hand as she stood frozen, I urged her to put her smartphone away.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Trainer... san...
choice_data_list: I'm sure things will settle down soon.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Still... but everyone—
choice_data_list: You should stay off social media and get some rest today

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Alongside Hokko Tarumae, who seemed utterly lost in thought, I walked back to the Academy in complete silence—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The next day.
The debate on social media about Hokko Tarumae
was still raging on fiercely...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Another factor was that the topic was picked up by online news, causing it to spread once again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My phone suddenly rings, so I check the screen.
Seeing that it's Hokko Tarumae, I hurriedly answer.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, Trainer.
Could I... take a little break today?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I'm feeling unwell, but...
Right now, um... I'd just like to be alone for a bit—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ......I just realized something.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...No, that's not it.
I actually noticed a while ago... but I was pretending not to notice...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Everything I've done up until now...
My desire to "spread the word about Tomakomai"...—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It didn't get across at all...
That they didn't think I was being serious—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—I have always sought to draw attention
by delivering results in my races.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: It was because I truly believed that if everyone looked at me, my words, my feelings, and my message would reach them.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
However... I was wrong. All everyone
cares about, all they ever look at...
is my future as a dirt Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...The same goes for local idol activities.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The only reason my entertainment-style content grew so much better
was simply because people were cheering me on
as an "idol"—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The local circuits... Tomakomai...
They weren't even watching us...—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Tomakomai is just a gimmick...!
In reality, she just wants to succeed
in races and as an idol...!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If it was going to make the fans feel that way,
I shouldn't have changed our strategy...!
And yet... I just focused on short-term numbers...!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"It's because I'm like this...
that people think I'm not taking things seriously...!!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "Ngh... uuugh...—"
choice_data_list: ...Could we meet up and talk for a bit?
...I wonder if we could meet up and talk for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was agonizingly frustrating.
If nothing else, I wanted to be by her side
and share her pain.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Even if what Hokko Tarumae says is true, I wanted to take our time and think through what we can do from here together."
choice_data_list: You've always been working so hard for Tomakomai
You've been working so hard for Tomakomai all this time.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Then that makes it all the more pointless...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I've been taking this seriously the whole time...!
If that sincerity isn't getting through—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: You really are utterly hopeless!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"‘...!! I-I'm so sorry...
I didn't mean it like that...—’"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"..................Just a little.
Just a tiny bit... please give me some time......"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "I will definitely get back in top shape by tomorrow, so..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Only the sound of the disconnected call echoed in the room.
Unusually loud, and cold."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...What words, what actions, what decisions
would be best for Hokko Tarumae right now?
As I stepped outside for some fresh air and pondered—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“—You weren't in the Trainer's office, so I came looking for you.
If you stay out here the whole time, you're gonna catch a cold, you know?”

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...I got worried about Tarumae-chan.
...Are you holding up alright, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—As I explain to Smart Falcon what Hokko Tarumae carries on her shoulders,
a wave of helplessness wells up inside me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Smart Falcon once told me,
'Please watch over Hokko Tarumae
up close.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And yet, I can neither perceive the quiet realization within her
nor find the right words to say, left only standing in silence—"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: “—Tarumae-chan is one of my most cherished juniors.”

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer is such a kind, hardworking person,
trying their absolute best
to be there for their precious junior.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Falco, do you mind if I
butt in on the two of them a little bit?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —"When in doubt, go back to the basics"!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
You know, I also had a time when I struggled a bit with what I wanted to do and my dreams.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"At a time like that, at a place I could call my starting point...
I was able to remember what I truly wanted to do."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And... as for where that starting point lies...
surely no one could notice it
except oneself and those closest to them—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
Where do you think Tarumae-chan's roots really are?
choice_data_list: Where it all began for Tarumae——

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —There was only one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And thanks to that word, "origins," I was able to remember something myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Why did I become Hokko Tarumae's
Trainer? Why did I want to support her?
It's time to remember that "starting point."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
You really are Tarumae-chan's Trainer, aren't you?
choice_data_list: ...There's something I'd like your help with.
...There's something I'd like your help with.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You've got an idea, don't you?
Leave it to me! For the sake of my precious junior,
Falco is ready to step up and help out~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Returning to the "starting point,"
so that she can run in the Kashiwa Kinen once more—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Smart Falcon's help, I took action to do
what I can right now...!
